call_points.text: Target of 10,000 keys by FY30 is on track with 85% visibility on the identified funnel.
Resort occupancy grew by 220 bps YoY to 75.6% in Q2 FY27.
TRevPAR increased 6% YoY to ₹8,777 per room as of September end.
Standalone cash balance stood at ₹1,329 Cr and deferred revenue was ₹5,828 Cr at September end.
Network keys stood at 5,762 across 106 resorts after exiting 6 resorts (net reduction of 103 keys) in Q2.
Company expects to add more than 1,000 keys in FY27 following a record 900 keys added in FY26.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an assessment order for AY 2020‑21 giving effect to the directions issued by the Dispute Resolution Panel. The Order makes additions aggregating to ₹13,38,60,587, which have been adjusted against brought‑forward losses, resulting in a net tax demand of ₹6,61,00,405. The additions are as follows: Interest on inter‑corporate deposits: ₹1,79,06,364 Corporate guarantee fees: ₹11,59,54,223
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle 1, LTU Chennai ('DCIT')
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received a Rectification Order dated July 15, 2025, communicated via email on February 25, 2026, from the DCIT. The order allows the carry‑forward of unabsorbed depreciation of ₹70,01,91,586 relating to AY 2017‑18 and grants a deduction of ₹50,00,000, which were not considered in the original assessment. Pursuant to the rectification, the earlier tax demand of ₹6,61,00,405 for AY 2020‑21 has been fully nullified, and a refund of ₹7,09,55,418 has been determined. The matter is currently pending adjudication before the Hon’ble Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT).

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an Order for AY 2022-23, raising a demand of Rs 72.14 Crore on account of additions made to the income due to Income Computation and Disclosure Standards (“ICDS”) adjustment and transfer pricing adjustment.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle 1, LTU Chennai ('DCIT')
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received a Rectification Order dated March 13, 2026 from the DCIT, allowing the carry‑forward of business losses of ₹96,15,85,578 and unabsorbed depreciation of ₹107,42,70,481, which were inadvertently not considered in the original assessment order. Pursuant to this rectification, the earlier tax demand of ₹72,13,53,760 for AY 2022‑23 has been fully nullified.

timeline.summary: Mahindra Holidays reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹844.00 Cr and approved the acquisition of Aditatva Estates Private Limited.
Mahindra Holidays & Resorts released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting resort expansion and financial performance.
MHRIL held Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on 27 April 2026 at 7:03 PM (IST) with audio recording available at clubmahindra.com.
Mahindra Holidays hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹844 Cr and announcing plans to add over 1,000 keys in FY27.
Mahindra Holidays announced the resignation of CFO Vimal Agarwal and the appointment of Rajiv Vimal as CFO effective July 1, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹784.13 Cr (+9.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹19.96 Cr.
Mahindra Holidays reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹3.95 Cr and PAT of ₹0.43 Cr.
MHRIL held an earnings conference call on October 21, 2026, discussing Q2 & H1 FY2027 performance with **Mansi Laheri** and **Shashwat Laheri** at 5:23 PM IST.
Mahindra Holidays reiterated plans to add 1,000 gross keys over the next 6 months and target 10,000 keys by FY30 during its Q2 FY27 earnings call.
